target.statement: Proximity kernel ('Ours') achieves NMI = 0.2289 on the Hepatitis dataset for K-means clustering with the ground-truth number of clusters.

compute.basis: The target is one NMI cell on the smallest UCI dataset (155 samples, 19 features); the method is simple binning/encoding plus K-means, and 5 bin counts x 10 repeats run in seconds to minutes on a CPU.

blockers: The code link is an anonymous.4open.science repository and may expire or be unavailable.
Exact random seeds, preprocessing details, and UCI data version are not fully specified for reproducing the 10-run average exactly.
title: Kernel Representation and Similarity Measure for Incomplete Data
